_comment: Read memory through the program buffer and compare against the ELF.
base_addr is REQUIRED by the builder -- it has no default. An earlier
version of this config omitted it, the client died on a TypeError, and
the simulator ran on with nothing driving it until the test burned its
whole timeout. A malformed config presented as a hung DUT.
DRAMBase, where the test program is loaded. 16 words is enough to
exercise the program-buffer read path without spending JTAG time on a
scan whose length proves nothing extra.
